title: aid-test-execution-ledger-v1
description: One entry per run unit ACTUALLY DISPATCHED during a gate run. The ledger exists to answer one question — did anything run twice? — and it can only answer it if every dispatch point appends. A gap is indistinguishable from an absence of duplication, which is why an append that cannot take its lock fails the run rather than being skipped.

candidate_sha.description: The revision under test. Two entries only collide if they describe the same code — a unit run against two different commits is two legitimate executions.

gate_id.description: Which gate this dispatch happened under. Two entries for one unit under the SAME gate id are one gate's own business (a retry, a repeat); under two different gate ids they are the double execution this ledger exists to find.

dispatch_point.description: Which of the four emission paths appended this. `gate_runner_direct` is the fourth and least obvious one: a gate whose command invokes a runner directly passes through none of the fan-out points, so without it the ledger would have certified this repository's own known double execution as clean.
